name.full: Sofra: lunch with colleagues from other teams

description.short: Say which days you are in; get seated with colleagues from other teams.
description.full: Pick the days you will be in the office and want lunch. Before your office opens, Sofra seats you with two or three colleagues from other departments and levels you have not had lunch with before, and sends the table its invite. Reply from the card, or drop out, and the table is reseated.
